question: What request did Hari make for the welfare of the worlds?
premises: Hari addressed the benefactor of the world.
The request concerned destruction of suffering.
inference: Hari asked the world-benefactor to speak for the destruction of the worlds' suffering.
uncertainties: Orthographic forms vvada, tva/, llokaśaṅkara follow the source text.
plain_english: O benefactor of the world, speak for the destruction of the suffering of the worlds.
